description:
Calculate an auditable material takeoff from explicit geometry or a
    supported SmartScale/ProtoGen measurement payload. Returns net, explicit
    waste-adjusted, and conservative purchase quantities. This is a planning
    estimate, not a guaranteed material order or professional certification.
    If a call returns indeterminate, the response includes first_call_help.
    Example arguments: {"items": [{"id": "slab-1", "assembly": "concrete_slab", "unit_system": "imperial", "dimensions": {"length": {"value": "20", "unit": "ft"}, "width": {"value": "30", "unit": "ft"}, "thickness": {"value": "4", "unit": "in"}}}], "options": {}}

TakeoffItem.description: One thing to quantify: an assembly and its dimensions.

assembly.description: What is being built. One of: aggregate_base, asphalt_shingle, brick_veneer, cmu_wall, concrete_column, concrete_footing, concrete_slab, concrete_wall, dimensional_lumber, drywall, excavation, paint, rebar_grid, sheathing, structural_steel, wood_wall_framing.
assembly.title: Assembly

dimensions.description: The measurements, each as {value, unit}. get_assembly names the dimensions an assembly needs.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

id.description: Your label for this item; it is echoed in the result.
id.title: Id

TakeoffItem.title: TakeoffItem

items.description: The items to quantify: a list of {id, assembly, unit_system, dimensions}. One item or a JSON string is also accepted.
items.title: Items

options.description: Optional. Extra settings for this call, as an object.
options.title: Options

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id
